description: This file defines the controller class for managing the 'Item' shipping extension in the admin panel of an OpenCart e-commerce platform. It contains methods for displaying configuration settings and saving updates, handling HTTP requests and generating views.

classes.name: Item
classes.description: Controller class for managing shipping item settings in admin panel, extending the core OpenCart Controller class.

methods.name: index
methods.description: Handles rendering of the shipping item configuration page, sets up breadcrumbs, retrieves configuration and related data for display.

methods.name: save
methods.description: Handles saving configuration updates, performs permission check, updates settings, and returns a JSON response indicating success or error.
